contributions.detail: Form A (page 2) is a wholly EMPTY 17-row grid: every data cell is blank and the printed footer reads 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS $  -'. The cover's line-1 THIS REPORT cell likewise prints a bare dash. Under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling a bare dash is a BLANK, not a 0, so there is no numeric figure to score the empty side against and the result is 'unknown' rather than 'exact'; the side itself is an honest zero (transcribed, zero rows), not a gap. FOR THE HUMAN, the document does carry internal evidence that this template's '-' is its zero FORMAT rather than an omission: line 1 CUMULATIVE 345.10 minus line 2 CUMULATIVE 345.10 = 0, and the balance row prints '-' in all three cells -- i.e. the dash occupies a cell whose value is provably zero. That is an argument about the template, not a transcription, so nothing was converted. NOTE ALSO that the 345.10 cumulative belongs to an EARLIER filing in this cycle; its itemisation is not in this document, so this PDF can never yield the donors behind that figure. IMPORTANT FORM VARIANT: this cover has NO '$50.00 or less' aggregate line at all -- the grid is three rows (contributions over $50, expenses, balance), so cover_le50_* is null (the field does not exist), not blank.

gates.page_subtotal: This form generation DOES print schedule totals, and both of them are nil dashes rather than numerals: p2 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS $ -' over an empty grid, p3 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES $ -' over an empty grid. With zero rows and no numeral in either footer there is no gate to fire -- reported as such rather than scored. The cover's own horizontal chains are the only numerals on the filing and they are consistent: 345.10 (LAST) + nil (THIS) = 345.10 (CUMULATIVE) on both line 1 and line 2.

gates.balance_chain: Closes, and it is the only arithmetic the filing offers. Line 1 (contributions over $50): 345.10 LAST + nil THIS = 345.10 CUMULATIVE. Line 2 (campaign expenses): 345.10 LAST + nil THIS = 345.10 CUMULATIVE. Balance row: all three cells print a bare dash, consistent with 345.10 - 345.10 = 0 (see the recon detail on how the dash was handled). No cover-to-cover chain test was possible: the earlier filing that carries the 345.10 is not in my chunk, so a human wanting to verify the LAST-REPORT cells must pull Ryan Sullivan's prior 2024 filing.

escalation_note: No escalation was needed or warranted: the document is a born-typed spreadsheet PDF, every character is crisp at 200 dpi, and both schedules are empty -- there was no disputed glyph, no cramped cents group and no row to re-verify.
